## Change

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Core Python tests run
- [ ] Native build/test run when native code changed
- [ ] Skipped or unavailable checks are listed with reasons
- [ ] No generated outputs, datasets, checkpoints, binaries, or toolchains added
- [ ] No production-readiness or global-optimum claim is introduced

## Data and artifacts

List any external data or artifact dependency and its version/hash. Write
`None` when the change has no such dependency.
